validation_selection_rule: Use newly trained motion and candidate pair; no tuning after validation; freeze before test; report all fixed cases including failures
train_label_policy: Only TRAIN fit/selection produce private actual-clock supervision; Native target states never enter model inputs
testing_policy: New generated Native heldout episodes; not archived official benchmark VAL/TEST; no test feedback for selection

raw_rgbd_policy: save current RGBD for reproducible public-input auditing
